Senior Technical Business Analyst | CSPO | PMP certified

sundar94@gmail.com

www.linkedin.com/in/sundarravisankar/

Senior Business Analyst with 9+ years of experience working across digital transformation, payments and banking projects. Iʼve gathered and clarified requirements, mapped end- -end processes, and worked closely with product, engineering, testing, and operations teams to deliver clear, scalable solutions. Iʼm hands on with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Power BI. I'm a certified SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) and a PMP practitioner.

to

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Technical Business Analyst, Platform Engineering, Elanco 01/2024 – Present Worked with engineering, product, QA, and security teams to gather requirements, define user stories, and translate platform needs into clear delivery plans. Led requirement workshops and process reviews for automation and developer experience initiatives, improving requirement clarity and reducing requirement rework by 40%. Mapped current vs. target processes and supported modernization efforts, contributing to cost savings of $100K+ annually and reducing manual effort by 30%. Defined and validated non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, compliance) for cloud-based tools running on Azure and GCP, ensuring enterprise readiness. Built monitoring and reporting dashboards in Power BI and Tableau to track deployment frequency, cycle time, and environment usage reducing provisioning delays Supported release readiness, documentation, and governance activities to ensure predictable delivery across distributed teams in the US, UK, and APAC.

—

by 25%.

Senior Business analyst | Agile Lead, Societe Generale 02/2021 – 01/2024 Led three Agile squads delivering improvements across digital workflows, reporting automation, and internal platforms—improving predictability and reducing sprint spillover by ~28%. Ran discovery workshops with business teams to gather requirements, refine scope, and create user stories, which reduced clarification loops and delays during build and testing. Improved data quality and validation logic for reporting and workflow automation, reducing manual review time by ~22% and improving accuracy of operational reporting. Contributed to solution design by analyzing integration rules, data flows, and system constraints, helping engineering teams estimate and deliver with fewer assumptions. Applied product and architectural concepts from platforms including Avaloq, Newgen BPM, Appian, and Pega to guide workflow configuration, onboarding logic, and automation rules. Coordinated UAT, regression testing, and release readiness using Jira, Confluence, and Zephyr, improving release quality and reducing last-minute issues by 35%.

11/2016 – 01/2021

Business analyst, Atos - Syntel Supported core banking programs at American Express across cards, payments, dispute handling, and merchant servicing, working closely with teams in the US and Europe. Gathered and translated business needs into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process flows for projects like card transaction processing improvements, chargeback workflow modernization, merchant settlement optimization, and fraud/risk monitoring. Worked closely with engineering teams to design system integrations across payment gateways, risk engines, settlement platforms, and dispute systems — improving data flow and reducing mapping-related defects in testing. Improved operational processes by documenting current vs. target workflows, identifying gaps, and simplifying steps, which reduced manual work and improved processing accuracy. Supported testing cycles by writing test cases, validating end- and regulatory expectations.

to

-end scenarios, logging issues, and ensuring releases met business

Business analysis and delivery: Requirement elicitation & validation, Business process modelling (AS-IS/TO-BE), End- mapping, Banking workflows (onboarding, payments, deposits, loans, investments), Risk & dependency tracking, OKRs, KPI-based delivery tracking, Cross-functional collaboration, Stakeholder alignment, Change control & governance reporting

Delivery and Frameworks: Waterfall, Agile (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban), SDLC, Sprint ceremonies, Backlog management, Release readiness and go-live coordination, Regression/UAT/Test scenario support, Continuous improvement

B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering, Sri Eshwar college of engineering

2012 – 05/2016
